description: Plumbline: Screen a person or company name against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list and its aliases (US OFAC SDN only: not the EU, UK or UN lists). Returns each match with its score, SDN entry number, type and programs, and the date the list was published. A match is a lead for review, not a determination. The list is in Latin script: a name in Cyrillic, Greek, Georgian, Armenian, Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, Chinese, Korean or Japanese kana is screened by transliteration (screened: "TRANSLITERATED", with the forms and systems tried, what could not be read, and how each match was found), which is weaker than the party's official Latin spelling, so pass that spelling too when you have it; a no-match answer of that kind is not a clean result. Weaker tiers come apart in leads, each labelled and never counted as a match: PARTIAL_NAME (part of a name shared with a listed one, too little to be that party; each lead says why) and SKELETON (a consonant-skeleton fit, the only comparison possible for Arabic, Persian and Hebrew, which therefore return leads and no matches); read summary and lead_counts as well as matches. Thai, Devanagari, other scripts and Japanese kanji are not transliterated and are answered as not screened.

name.description: The person's or company's name as written, in any script; aliases are searched too
